description: This file defines the API and data structures for a packed buffer (pbuf) used in inter-process communication within the Zephyr RTOS, including configuration macros, data structures, and function prototypes for initialization, reading, and writing.

methods.name: pbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes the packet buffer based on provided configuration.

methods.name: pbuf_write
methods.description: Writes specified amount of data to the packet buffer if it fits.

methods.name: pbuf_read
methods.description: Reads specified amount of data from the packet buffer.
